scenarios.title: A search for cards matching an undefined quality finds nothing

setup.notes: Library lists are top first. B's hand is empty.

decisions: A casts Lobotomy targeting B, tapping Island, Island, Swamp and Swamp.
B reveals the hand; A chooses a card other than a basic land card if there is one.

variants.label: empty-hand
variants.expected: B's hand is empty, so no card is chosen. A searches B's graveyard, hand and library but finds nothing: B's Grizzly Bears stays in B's graveyard and in B's library, and nothing moves to exile. Lobotomy resolves.

variants.label: bears-in-hand
variants.delta: B's hand holds one Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: A chooses Grizzly Bears. A finds the same name in all three zones: the Grizzly Bears from B's hand, graveyard and library all move to exile, three cards in total.

scenarios.forge_notes: Lobotomy's ChooseCard step with no valid choice should end the chain; the library shuffle at the end may or may not still run.

scenarios.title: A search for a quantity of cards must find a card when the library holds one
decisions: A casts Demonic Tutor, tapping Swamp and Swamp.
Both players pass; Demonic Tutor resolves.
A searches the library for a card and chooses Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: library-of-three
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears moves from A's library to A's hand. A's library has two cards left and is shuffled.

variants.label: empty-library
variants.expected: Demonic Tutor resolves and finds no card because the library holds none. A's hand stays empty.

variants.label: single-card-library
variants.delta: A's library holds only one Forest.
variants.expected: A has no choice and must find the Forest: it moves to A's hand and the library is empty.

scenarios.title: A found card is revealed only when the search says so
decisions: A casts Vampiric Tutor, tapping Swamp.
Both players pass; Vampiric Tutor resolves.
A searches the library for a card and chooses Lightning Bolt.

variants.label: no-reveal
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt is not revealed: B is shown nothing. Lightning Bolt ends on top of A's library after a shuffle of the other two cards, and A loses 2 life (18).

variants.label: reveal
variants.delta: A's hand holds Mystical Tutor instead of Vampiric Tutor and A casts it, tapping Island.
variants.expected: The instruction reveals the card: Lightning Bolt is revealed to B. It ends on top of A's library after a shuffle of the other two cards. A's life stays 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge has no trigger mode for revealing a card, so the reveal is visible only in the game log; record fields do not capture it.

scenarios.title: Searching the top four cards instead still counts as searching the library
decisions: A passes priority with an empty stack.
B casts Vampiric Tutor, tapping Swamp.
Both players pass; Vampiric Tutor resolves.
B searches the top four cards of the library (Aven Mindcensor) and chooses a Forest.
Archivist of Oghma's trigger goes on the stack and resolves.

variants.label: opponent-searches
variants.expected: Archivist of Oghma triggers: A gains 1 life (21) and draws Island. B's chosen Forest ends on top of B's library, Grizzly Bears (the fifth card) was out of reach, and B loses 2 life (18).

variants.label: own-search
variants.delta: The searcher is A: Vampiric Tutor is in A's hand instead of B's, and A casts it, tapping A's Swamp, and chooses an Island.
variants.expected: Aven Mindcensor does not limit A's own search and Archivist of Oghma does not trigger on A's search: A's life is 18 and A draws nothing.

variants.label: no-mindcensor
variants.delta: Aven Mindcensor is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: B searches the whole library. Archivist of Oghma still triggers: A gains 1 life (21) and draws Island.

scenarios.forge_notes: Aven Mindcensor is implemented as the LimitSearchLibrary keyword on opponents; whether Archivist's SearchedLibrary trigger fires on a limited search is the point to check.
